config:
# Optuna tuning du qualifieur, adaptée à Jean Zay. Mêmes placeholders @-délimités que
# jz/synonym_config.yml, substitués par jz/slurm/synonym_tune.slurm.
#
# Espace de recherche volontairement restreint à ce que l'ablation a laissé ouvert :
#   - PAS de `hard` : la variante a2-hardneg s'est effondrée, la question est tranchée ;
#   - PAS de nombre d'époques : c'est les runs longs (a0-long, a1-long) qui le situent ;
#   - backbone PUBLIC : PARTAGES ne gagne qu'un point, et le tuning cherche des réglages
#     transférables au corpus corrigé, pas un modèle final.

vars:
  hf_token: null
  data_path: "/lustre/fsn1/projects/rech/sxf/uhq31wo/CU2/synonym/V2_avril_2026/"
  df_pos: "phase1_df_pos.pkl"
  df_neg: "df_neg.pkl"
  val_dataset: "phase1_test_inclusion.pkl"
  output_path: "/lustre/fsn1/projects/rech/sxf/uhq31wo/CU2/runs/synonym/tune-public-s7/"
  seed: 42

model_params:
  model_name: "/lustre/fsmisc/dataset/HuggingFace_Models/almanach/camembertav2-base"
  hf_token: ${vars.hf_token}
  hidden_layer: 512
  activation: "gelu"
  dropout: 0.1
  pooling: "mean"
  sigma: 0.
  freeze_encoder: False

warmup_config:
  warmup_epochs: 2
  encoder_learning_rate: 1e-6
  classifier_learning_rate: 1e-3
  weight_decay: 1e-2
  sampling_probs:
    hard: 1.0
    cat: 0.
    bloc: 0.7

train_config:
  train_epochs: 20
  encoder_learning_rate: 1e-5
  classifier_learning_rate: 5e-5
  weight_decay: 1e-4
  sampling_probs:
    hard: 0.
    cat: 0.
    bloc: 0.9

hyperparameters:
  model_params.dropout:
    alias: "dropout"
    type: "float"
    low: 0.1
    high: 0.4
    step: 0.1
  train_config.sampling_probs.bloc:
    alias: "sampling_bloc"
    type: "float"
    low: 0.5
    high: 0.9
    step: 0.1
  train_config.encoder_learning_rate:
    alias: "encoder_lr"
    type: "float"
    low: 5e-6
    high: 3e-5
    log: True
  train_config.weight_decay:
    alias: "weight_decay"
    type: "categorical"
    choices: [1.0e-4, 1.0e-3, 1.0e-2]
  train_config.classifier_learning_rate:
    alias: "classifier_lr"
    type: "float"
    low: 2e-5
    high: 2e-4
    log: True

tune:
  model_params: ${model_params}
  hf_token: ${vars.hf_token}
  data_path: ${vars.data_path}
  df_pos: ${vars.df_pos}
  df_neg: ${vars.df_neg}
  val_dataset: ${vars.val_dataset}
  batch_size: 180
  max_length: 200
  warmup_config: ${warmup_config}
  train_config: ${train_config}
  hyperparameters: ${hyperparameters}
  n_trials: 9
  n_epochs_per_trial: 15
  output_path: ${vars.output_path}
  model_weights: "best_model_tune.pt"
  seed: ${vars.seed}
  # sampler_seed distinct par job : deux études parallèles explorent des points différents,
  # et l'union des essais couvre l'espace deux fois plus vite qu'une étude séquentielle.
  sampler_seed: 7
  exp_dir: "/lustre/fsn1/projects/rech/sxf/uhq31wo/CU2/runs/synonym/tune-public-s7"
  pruner_type: "median"
